**Your experience matters**

UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital - Fitchburg is part of Lifepoint Health, a diversified healthcare delivery network with facilities coast to coast. We are driven by a profound commitment to prioritize your well-being so you can provide exceptional care to others. By joining our team, you’re embracing a vital mission dedicated to making communities healthier ®. Join us on this meaningful journey where your skills, compassion and dedication will make a remarkable difference in the lives of those we serve. C

UW Health Rehabilitation Hospital - Fitchburg is a brand-new 40 bed inpatient rehabilitation facility opening in 2027. We offer high-quality, compassionate care for a wide variety of patients in need. We strive to maximize the health, function, and quality of life of those we serve through comprehensive physical medicine and rehabilitation programs.

A Director of Plant Operations who excels in this role:

* Develops and recommends departmental policies and procedures.
* Develops programs to ensure departmental effectiveness.
* Monitors existing policies, procedures

* Experience: Experience in hospital operations and survey preparedness highly preferred

Sr Manager, Outsourced Manufacturing
At Gilead, we’re creating a healthier world for all people. We continue to fight against the world’s biggest health challenges, and our mission requires collaboration, determination and a relentless drive to make a difference.
 
 Every member of Gilead’s team plays a critical role in the discovery and development of life-changing scientif

e oversees, and contributes to, as required, technical and operational activities to ensure continued supply of clinical and commercial drug products manufactured by Gilead’s external contract manufacturing network. 
 The role requires collaboration with the Technical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Analytical, Supply Chain, and Product & Portfolio Strategy organizations within PDM to ensure successful technology transfer/validation, commercialization, launch, routine supply, and proactive management of changes across the product lifecycle.

 This position will be based at the Gilead Foster

The role requires collaboration with the Technical Development, Quality, Regulatory, Analytical, Supply Chain, and Product & Portfolio Strategy organizations within PDM to ensure successful technology transfer/validation, commercialization, launch, routine supply, and proactive management of changes across the product lifecycle.

 This position will be based at the Gilead Foster City campu s.

 Job Responsibilities : 

 Responsible, within GEM, to execute on Gilead’s supply network strategy; part of the team that defines the technical requirements for selection of CMOs.
 Leads or represents G

ical, Supply Chain, and Product & Portfolio Strategy organizations within PDM to ensure successful technology transfer/validation, commercialization, launch, routine supply, and proactive management of changes across the product lifecycle.

 This position will be based at the Gilead Foster City campu s.

 Job Responsibilities : 

 Responsible, within GEM, to execute on Gilead’s supply network strategy; part of the team that defines the technical requirements for selection of CMOs.
 Leads or represents GEM on one or more CMO Management Teams that influences overall performance of the CMO to ach

Our environment respects individual differences and recognizes each employee as an integral member of our company. Our workforce reflects these values and celebrates the individuals who make up our growing team. 
 
 Gilead provides a work environment free of harassment and prohibited conduct. We promote and support individual differences and diversity of thoughts and opinion. 
 
 For Current Gilead Employees and Contractors: 
 Please apply via the Internal Career Opportunities portal in Workday.

Identifies and facilitates execution of continuous improvement initiatives to reduce costs, improve quality, increase efficiency, and ensure sustainability of supply.
